name: tsa_validateInviteToken
description: Validates a registration QR token and returns the invite (id, names) when it exists, is unused and is unexpired; otherwise a refusal envelope with a user-facing message. Read-only. Called by the TSA Eats Next.js app (tsa-eats/lib/api.ts) through api/Endpoints/TsaApi.cs, which maps queryType 'validateInviteToken' to [TSA].[tsa_validateInviteToken]. There is no Harrier Central auth: POST requires the shared X-Api-Key (TsaApiKey); GET requires nothing, and the shim does not restrict which procedure a GET may name. The shim turns any one-row rowset with Success = 0 into HTTP 400 {success:false, errorMessage}, and an empty first rowset into HTTP 404.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Token from the QR code URL. No default.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Instead of Invite: unknown token (line 29), already used (line 35) or expired (line 41). ErrorMessage is always fixed text here.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed user-facing text, or ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block (raw SQL Server text).

codeSmells.detail: @token (line 2) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the body runs: no log row, and the TsaApi shim returns a generic 500.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: Read procedure with no TRY/CATCH: any runtime error (timeout, deadlock) becomes an unlogged raw 500 from the shim.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
